note: Capabilities the schema declares that nothing in the application creates YET, each with what it is for and the decision on it. tools/capability-audit.js --strict passes while every entry here is accurate and FAILS on any new table that nothing can create — so this list is a to-do that cannot quietly grow.

entries.purpose: Regulatory permits per branch (SON/SONCAP, fire, weights and measures) with expiry dates; v_compliance_expiry_alerts already warns about them.
entries.decision: WIRE UP — the verticals carry compliance rules (SONCAP/SON) and the alert view is already built and unused. Next stage: record permits per branch and show the expiries the view already computes.

entries.purpose: Who could see which branch and till, and when — so "who could see the Minna till on 14 March?" stays answerable after a transfer.
entries.decision: WIRE UP — audit-adjacent, cheap: write a row whenever a user's branch or business changes.

entries.purpose: A staff transfer that the RECEIVING manager must accept, so a cashier cannot be silently moved to a branch nobody is staffing.
entries.decision: WIRE UP — the accept/decline flow is the missing half; the table and its intent are already designed.

entries.purpose: Delivery zones (area, fee, minimum order) for the delivery and installation jobs that delivery_jobs already records.
entries.decision: WIRE UP — delivery fees are charged by hand today; the zone table is how they become a rule.

entries.purpose: Vehicles and riders, so a delivery can be assigned to one and its cost traced.
entries.decision: LATER — useful once zones exist and there is more than one van to track.

entries.purpose: The serial numbers that moved with a branch transfer, so a warranty claim can be traced back to the transfer that moved the unit.
entries.decision: WIRE UP — serial tracking is in scope and transfers already move serial-tracked goods; this is the record that makes the movement provable.

entries.purpose: Recalls: which products, which batches, what was done with the stock that came back.
entries.decision: LATER — genuinely valuable for appliances and building materials, but a whole flow (identify, quarantine, notify, report) that deserves its own stage.

entries.purpose: A record of housekeeping runs (purged sessions, expired holds, pruned sync logs).
entries.decision: WIRE UP — worker/src/housekeeping.js already runs the work; it simply does not record what it did.

entries.purpose: NOT A CAPABILITY — the intermediate name of the SQLite table-rebuild in schema/migrations/0006_sync_status_per_device.sql, which renames the result to branch_sync_status two statements later. The scanner reads every CREATE TABLE in every migration, so a rebuild always shows up here.
entries.decision: RECORDED, NOT WIRED — there is nothing to create. If this name ever appears outside 0006, the migration was copied and the copy matters.
